command:
set -eu
useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash appworker
umask 022
printf '%s\n' 'appworker soft nofile 8192' 'appworker hard nofile 8192' 'appworker soft nproc 256' 'appworker hard nproc 256' > /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
chown root:root /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
chmod 0644 /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
printf '%s\n' 'account-and-limits-created'

set -eu

chown root:root /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
chmod 0644 /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
printf '%s\n' 'account-and-limits-created'

set -eu
printf '%s\n' '== account ==' 
getent passwd appworker
printf '%s\n' '== persisted limits configuration ==' 
cat /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
printf '%s\n' '== fresh PAM login session ==' 
runuser --login appworker --command 'id; awk '\''/^Max open files|^Max processes/ {print}'\'' /proc/self/limits'
